svg.text: Cycles per instruction: baseline vs performance edition (predictor on, caches included)
Grey: baseline build. Blue: caches + tournament predictor + BTB + return address stack + precise load stalls + iterative M unit. The ideal is 1.0.

* uses multiply or divide: slower per instruction on the performance edition (8 cycles per multiply, 4 + dividend bits per divide), in exchange for a ~27x faster clock. Cold cache misses weigh heavily on the shortest programs.
